primary_sources.finding: fatal(err) prints generic Missing or invalid credentials then the error; IPCClient askpass rejection enters that function.
IPC client gets local socket path from VSCODE_GIT_IPC_HANDLE and sends request through that socket; connection errors reject the request.
VS Code supplies GIT_ASKPASS through terminal environment integration and handles Git credential requests.
Documents credential helpers and askpass/terminal selection.
